# myClinicalLabs

> myClinicalLabs is a HIPAA-compliant patient portal for Clinical Labs of Hawaii enabling secure access to test results and health information across multiple island locations.

myClinicalLabs serves patients of Clinical Labs of Hawaii with a comprehensive digital portal for account management, test result access, and health record retrieval. The platform operates across multiple locations on Oahu, Hawaii Island, Maui, Kauai, and Lanai.

## Key Topics

- myClinicalLabs Patient Portal
- Clinical Labs of Hawaii
- Account Access
- Sign-In / Login

- Health Information

## Account Access & Authentication

- [myClinicalLabs Sign In](https://my.clinicallabs.com): myClinicalLabs patient portal sign-in for Clinical Labs of Hawaii
- [Instant Portal Activation](https://my.clinicallabs.com/Public/UserAdmin/InstantPortalActivation.aspx): Account setup and instant portal activation guide for myClinicalLabs
- [Forgot Password](https://my.clinicallabs.com/Public/UserAdmin/ForgotPassword.aspx): Password reset and account recovery for myClinicalLabs users
